purpose: Pinned inventory of third-party declaration diagnostics retained by the ADR-0004 client exception. The accepted client compiler gate skips checking inside declaration files; this file is what keeps the vendor defects visible. pnpm --filter @udg/client typecheck:declarations reproduces it, and tests/contracts/UDG-SPIKE-001.test.ts compares the live inventory against this document and fails on any difference.
measuredOn: 2026-11-19, branch codex/udg-gate-a-browser-sdk at the UDG-SPIKE-001 slice-2 build

classification.note: Class A (TS2304 'Cannot find name HeadersInit', 18+1 entries in the server inventory) does not fire under the browser library set: lib.dom declares HeadersInit. The client-shape strict inventory is therefore 3, not the server's 27, and docs/integration/colyseus-declaration-inventory.json is unchanged by this document.

runtimeConsequence: None measured. All three diagnostics are inside declarations the emitted browser bundle never executes, and tests/e2e/netcode.spec.ts runs the same import end to end in two browser contexts. Strict vendor diagnostics and runtime behaviour are recorded as separate claims in docs/integration/colyseus-0.18-api-map.md.
rejectedAlternative: Importing the public subpath '@colyseus/sdk/Client' instead of the documented root import is worse, not cleaner: it adds 6 TS2591 'Cannot find name Buffer' defects in Connection.d.ts, transport/ITransport.d.ts and msgpackr/index.d.ts, whose only relief would be @types/node in a browser project (refused by the ambient-type policy).
